Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
// 2

public class MathOperations {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		try {
			int[] nums = new int[5];

			int sum = 0;

			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

				nums[i] = Integer.parseInt(args[i]);
				sum = sum + nums[i];

			}

			double avg = sum / 5.0;

			System.out.println("Average : " + avg);

		} catch (ArithmeticException e) {

			System.out.println(e);

		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {

			System.out.println(e);

		}

	}

}
